# chezmoi source

This folder is the chezmoi source for this machine's setup, applied with `os sync`. chezmoi ignores this
README (see `.chezmoiignore`). Naming follows chezmoi's conventions: `dot_config/x` → `~/.config/x`, and
`*.tmpl` files are templates. Usage is described in `.os/README.md`.
